name: KUI
subtitle: A simple desktop app for Kafka
tagline: Your Kafka cluster, at a glance
summary: Most Kafka tools are command-line scripts or web dashboards you have to deploy. KUI is a desktop app: download it, add your cluster, and you’re looking at your data.
description: Most Kafka tools are either command-line scripts or web dashboards you have to deploy and keep running. KUI is neither.
It’s a desktop app: download it, add your cluster, and you’re looking at your data.
